concepts.picture: A huge brass compass dominates the lower two-thirds, its needle pointing down towards south. A smaller graded Earth globe and magnetic field lines behind it give planetary scale. This illustrates a reversal, not a claim that the present drift has already reversed the field.

concepts.picture: A single enormous green-and-crimson aurora curtain over a recognisable London skyline (Westminster / Big Ben), with a tiny human silhouette at lower left for scale.
